Components / Reasoning

Task

What the agent did or is doing: status per row, animated on change, with file chips that flow and wrap. Collapsed by default on a phone — status stays glanceable on the trigger row — the one divergence from the web original, which opens by default.

  • v0.2.1
  • component
  • nativewind
  • uniwind
  • runs in Expo Go

Install

npx @react-native-reusables/cli@latest add https://rnraielements.com/r/nativewind/task.json
npx @react-native-reusables/cli@latest add https://rnraielements.com/r/uniwind/task.json

Usage
